questions.question: Driving a combination vehicle ____ than driving a single vehicle.
questions.explanation: Driving a combination vehicle requires more skill than driving a single vehicle. Combination vehicles are longer and heavier than single commercial vehicles.

questions.question: What does the trailer air supply control look like?
questions.explanation: The trailer air supply control on newer vehicles is an eight-sided red knob. It controls the tractor protection valve.

questions.question: When uncoupling a trailer, landing gear should be:
questions.explanation: When uncoupling, lower the landing gear until it touches the ground firmly. If the trailer is loaded, turn the crank a few more times to remove some weight from the trailer.

questions.question: Glad hands are:
questions.explanation: Glad hands are coupling devices that connect the air lines from the tractor to the trailer's air brake system.

questions.question: Push in the trailer air supply control to:
questions.explanation: Push in the trailer air supply control to send air to the trailer. Pull it out to turn off the air supply and activate the emergency brakes.

questions.question: To lower the risk of a rollover, you should:

options.text: Load cargo as far forward as possible
Load cargo as far back as possible
Load cargo as low as possible
Stack cargo as high as possible

questions.correctAnswerText: Load cargo as low as possible
questions.explanation: To reduce rollover risk, keep cargo as low as possible. Also take curves and corners slowly.

questions.question: What is another name for the service line?
questions.explanation: The trailer service air line is also called the control line or signal line.

questions.question: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS):

options.text: Makes it easier to turn a large vehicle

questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents wheels from locking up during hard braking.

questions.question: What is a tractor protection valve?

options.text: A valve that keeps air in the brake system if there is a bad leak
A valve that prevents the truck from being stolen
A valve that prevents the driver from going too fast
A valve that prevents the trailer from accidentally disconnecting

questions.correctAnswerText: A valve that keeps air in the brake system if there is a bad leak
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve keeps air in the truck brake system if the trailer disconnects or develops a leak.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve:

options.text: Should always be used for parking
Should only be used for parking downhill
Should never be used for parking
Should only be used when carrying cargo

questions.correctAnswerText: Should never be used for parking
questions.explanation: Never use the trailer hand valve for parking. It can cause air to leak out of the braking system, which releases the brakes. Use the parking brake instead.

questions.question: What happens when a trailer's wheels lock up?

options.text: The trailer will continue to move in a straight line.
The trailer may swing to the side.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer may swing to the side.
questions.explanation: A trailer may swing out and hit other vehicles if its wheels lock up. This happens more often with lightly-loaded trailers.

questions.question: Driving a combination vehicle requires _____ skill than driving a single vehicle.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles require more skill to drive than single vehicles. They are longer, heavier, and more likely to roll over.

questions.question: Before driving, check that air reaches all trailers by:

options.text: Opening the rear shut-off valves and listening for escaping air.
Closing the rear shut-off valves and listening for escaping air.
Disconnecting air supply lines and listening for escaping air.
Rolling each trailer down a hill and testing the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Opening the rear shut-off valves and listening for escaping air.
questions.explanation: Before a trip, make sure air reaches all trailers through the air brake system. Wait for air pressure to build, then send air to the emergency and service lines. Open the shut-off valves on the rear of the last trailer. If air escapes from these valves, air is reaching the entire vehicle.

questions.question: Rollovers happen when drivers:
questions.explanation: A rollover happens when a driver takes a turn at too high a speed. Always take turns and curves slowly and safely.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve should be used:

options.text: Often to activate the trailer brakes while driving.
Only to test the trailer brakes.
Only in bad weather when the trailer may skid.
Only when the trailer is carrying a load.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to test the trailer brakes.
questions.explanation: Use the trailer hand valve only to test the trailer brakes. Do not use it while driving because it may cause the trailer to skid.

questions.question: Avoid sudden lane changes by:

options.text: Using your horn to make other drivers move.
Driving slower than the speed limit.
Pulling off the road during heavy traffic.

questions.explanation: Sudden lane changes are dangerous when driving a combination vehicle. Look ahead for obstacles that require a lane change. This helps you avoid making sudden moves.

questions.question: If you cannot back your trailer in a straight line, you should:

options.text: Swerve back and forth while backing.

questions.explanation: If you must back your trailer along a curved path, back toward the driver's side. This gives you the best view while backing.

questions.question: When glad hands are color-coded, which color marks the service lines?
questions.explanation: Service lines are color-coded blue. Emergency lines are color-coded red.

questions.question: When coupling a trailer:

options.text: Any glad hand can connect to any other glad hand.
Connect only one set of glad hands.

questions.explanation: Connect matching glad hands when coupling. They are often color-coded to prevent mistakes. Blue is used for service lines and red is used for emergency lines.

questions.question: A tractor protection valve:

options.text: Keeps air in the tractor or truck brake system if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak.
Allows the battery to recharge efficiently.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keeps air in the tractor or truck brake system if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak.
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve on combination vehicles with air brakes keeps air in the tractor or truck brake system if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak.
